_meta.task: Task #2 — standardized production-impact target (one consistent definition)
_meta.definition: Peak % decline in real production volume of the directly-shocked sector in the source country at the trough vs pre-shock counterfactual; for chokepoint/logistics events, peak % throughput/transit reduction.
_meta.source: Perplexity deep research, primary/official sources only

records.source: JAMA official monthly release (2011-05-31), Japan domestic vehicle production
records.note: Node-level peak. Engine's current observed=0.039 is a GLOBAL-ANNUAL figure; this is JPN domestic monthly peak.

records.source: VDA provisional, Germany passenger-car production Oct 2021
records.note: German auto output peak monthly decline. Energy-crisis shock node is DEU:automotive.

records.source: CAAM Brief Analysis Apr 2022 via OICA
records.note: China vehicle production peak monthly decline.

records.source: CAAM official statistics Feb 2020 (corroborated China Daily / Al Jazeera)
records.note: China vehicle production Feb 2020 -79% YoY — depth of the first COVID lockdown.

records.source: UNESCAP/ARTNeT citing BOT/FTI auto production index (444.5 -> 62.5)
records.note: Derived index, not a direct METI/BOT primary release -> medium confidence.

records.source: Suez Canal Authority — complete blockage, zero transits 6 days
records.note: Total closure = 100% throughput loss.

records.source: SCA Chairman Osama Rabie official statement (cargo tonnage)
records.note: Suez cargo tonnage -41% YoY during the rerouting peak.

records.source: ACP FY2024 transit statistics (22 vs 36 daily transits)
records.note: Daily transits cut from 36 to 22.

records.source: CCNR Annual Market Observation Report 2019
records.note: Rhine waterway freight -27%. No dedicated Rhine node; proxied to DEU:automotive input bottleneck.

records.source: YICT/Hutchison Ports operational updates; Maersk advisory
records.note: Terminal-level (~20-30% running). Engine node is all-CHN shipping, so facility-level overstates the node.

records.source: Ningbo-Zhoushan Port Group official statement (China Daily)
records.note: Port-group throughput -10% MoM (Meishan = 1 of 4 terminals). Not in engine event set yet.

records.source: Renesas (TSE:6723) timely-disclosure filings
records.note: 100% is the N3 300mm LINE only; N2 200mm line unaffected and other JPN fabs run. Facility, not national-sector index.

records.source: DOSM Malaysia IPI, Jul 2021
records.note: FULL manufacturing index (-6.5%), NOT semiconductors. E&E sub-sector actually +8.6% YoY by Aug 2021 -> the semi target is effectively ~null.

records.source: GSO Vietnam IIP (not sector-specific)
records.note: National industrial production index, not electronics-specific.

records.source: Taiwan DGBAS / digi.taiwan.gov
records.note: Taiwan semi output GREW +20.7% YoY in 2020 — NO source-side production decline. The shock was demand/allocation, not output destruction; the real target is the DOWNSTREAM auto loss (engine already uses 0.115).

records.source: (no government statistics agency)
records.note: No official agency isolated a US auto peak-loss % attributable to chips alone — all public figures are consultant estimates/guidance ranges.

records.source: (Samsung/NXP/Infineon shutdown confirmed, no index)
records.note: Full fab shutdown confirmed but no Federal Reserve / Census series publishes Austin fab output as a discrete index %.

records.source: TSMC disclosures (EDN); no Taiwan MOEA/DGBAS monthly index for 1999
records.note: TSMC disclosed ~2-3 weeks lost production, but no official monthly semiconductor production index exists for Sep 1999.

records.source: Customs export VALUE data (businessreport)
records.note: Export VALUE fell (-3.2% overall / -22% to US) but NBS production VOLUME for electronics kept GROWING — the original target conflated trade value with output.

records.source: (no NBS/MIIT sector figure)
records.note: Short-lived (days); no sector-specific production-loss % published.

records.source: Destatis annual waterway freight (-6.4%)
records.note: Only an ANNUAL waterway-freight figure exists; no peak-month throughput % published by CCNR for 2022.

records.source: Port of LA FY2020/21 record 10.9M TEU (+21%)
records.note: Throughput was NOT lost, only delayed (record TEU handled). peak_throughput_loss_pct is conceptually inapplicable — this is a latency shock, not a volume shock.

records.source: BOJ noted economic pressure; no METI sector %
records.note: No METI semiconductor/electronics peak-output % for Hokkaido Sep 2018 published.
